title: Plug-and-Play Interpretable Responsible Text-to-Image Generation via Dual-Space Multi-facet Concept Control

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a deviation ratio to measure the disparity in generated gender representations across 35 different professions using the WinoBias dataset, including the use of 'challenging prompts' that typically amplify stereotypical male associations.
Calculating a deviation ratio to measure the disparity in generated racial representations (white, asian, black) across various professions using an extended version of the WinoBias dataset.

Qualitatively and visually evaluating the model's ability to disentangle and control age-related concepts (young, middle-aged, elderly) when generating images of different professions to reduce stereotypical age associations.
